mentions.name: InspoChef
mentions.description: A recipe inspiration and meal planning app. Chef personalities generate interesting recipes every couple of days, which users can save and edit to suit their needs and ingredients. Users can schedule weekly meal plan generations that turn the inspiration content into a weekly plan and shopping list. Instacart API integration is planned so the cart for the meal plan is built automatically, aiming for a one-click weekly confirmation, and the app also works for scheduling baby meals.
mentions.problem: After having a first child, the builder had more trouble getting things together for home cooked meals and wanted to make that as frictionless as possible.
